script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

Title: WINE AND DINE

INT. NEW YORK APARTMENT - DAY

JESSICA (mid 30s, ambitious, determined, dressed to impress), sits at her kitchen table, hunched over her laptop, scribbling away at a food blog entry.

JESSICA
(whispers to herself)
This is it. The big one. The post that will put me on the culinary map.

JESSICA's roommate RACHEL (early 30s, laid-back, artistic, enters from living room, wearing an apron)
Jess, you've been at that thing for hours. What is it this time?

JESSICA
(laughs nervously)
Just the next big recipe, Rachel. I've got to get it perfect.

RACHEL
(smiling)
Alright, well, why don't you take a break and join me for lunch? I made us some delicious quiche.

INT. NEW YORK APARTMENT - KITCHEN - LATER

JESSICA and RACHEL sit down at the kitchen table to enjoy the quiche.

JESSICA
(still a little distracted)
You know, I've been thinking... I want to start my own cooking channel. I could call it "Jessica's Kitchen."

RACHEL
(smiling)
That's a great idea, Jess. You've got the talent and the drive. What's holding you back?

JESSICA
(pauses)
Money. Equipment. Time. I don't have the resources to get started.

RACHEL
Well, there's got to be a way. Maybe we could start a crowdfunding campaign. Or, you know, you could try asking that wealthy uncle of yours for a loan.

JESSICA
(sighs)
I've asked him before. He's not exactly a fan of my culinary aspirations.

INT. WINE SHOP - DAY

JESSICA walks into a local wine shop, carrying her laptop. The OWNER (mid 50s, sophisticated, friendly) greets her warmly.

OWNER
Jessica! Welcome back. What brings you to my humble establishment today?

JESSICA
I'm working on a new blog post. A wine pairing post. I was hoping to get some expert advice from you.

OWNER
(pleased)
Of course, Jessica. I'd be happy to help. Let me show you some of our finest wines.

INT. WINE SHOP - TASTING ROOM - LATER

JESSICA and the OWNER sit down to taste various wines, discussing their unique flavors and pairing possibilities.

JESSICA
This one is perfect for a rich beef dish. What's the name?

OWNER
(pauses, thinking)
Let me check. Ah, this is our "Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve." It's a real crowd-pleaser.

INT. NEW YORK APARTMENT - NIGHT

JESSICA and RACHEL sit on the couch, watching a cooking channel.

RACHEL
(pointing at the screen)
You could be just as good as her, Jess. You've got the personality and the passion.

JESSICA
(smiling)
I know, but I need a little more than that to make it in the industry.

Suddenly, there's a knock at the door. It's JESSICA's UNCLE TOM (late 60s, stern, business-savvy).

UNCLE TOM
Jessica, I've heard about your culinary endeavors. I want to talk to you about it.

JESSICA
(surprised)
Uncle Tom, I thought you weren't supportive of my cooking dreams.

UNCLE TOM
(sighs)
Jessica, I've been watching you for a long time. I've seen your determination and your passion. I'm proud of you. But you can't just wing it. You need a solid plan and some financial backing. I'm willing to help you get started.

JESSICA
(overwhelmed with emotion)
Uncle Tom, I can't believe it. Thank you so much!

INT. NEW YORK APARTMENT - KITCHEN - DAY

JESSICA and RACHEL are cooking and laughing together. JESSICA holds up a camera and smiles at the screen.

JESSICA
(into camera)
And welcome to "Jessica's Kitchen!" Today, we're making a delicious pasta dish...

FADE OUT.

THE END.
